cards.title: Theorem 1 of arXiv:2304.12110: Exponential decay of the volume for Bernoulli percolation: a proof via stochastic comparis
cards.body: Theorem 1. For every p < p_c, there exist c, C > 0 such that for all n >= 0, psi_n(p) <= C e^{-cn}. Here the setting is Bernoulli bond percolation of parameter p on a connected, locally finite, vertex-transitive and countably infinite graph G = (V, E) (e.g. Z^d), with a fixed vertex o; C_o is the open cluster of o, p_c := inf{p in [0, 1] : P_p[|C_o| = +infinity] > 0} is the critical probability, and psi_n(p) := P_p[|C_o| >= n].
